_purpose: Ground-truth table for slice 5.0/5.1. Bake through the post-process ABP with export_pose_transforms.py; diff against riglogic_eval.py (the Python oracle) and riglogic_probe (Epic's compiled library).

_bands.single-control: every raw control alone at 1.0 -- isolates one matrix column
_bands.viseme-pair: t=0.5 blends ranked by corrective activation

poses.name: viseme__viseme_PP
poses.note: Bilabial stop. The seal is the whole signature -- lips together and compressed, jaw shut. MEASURED CORRECTION 2026-08-22: at press 0.34 this baked to 4.03 mm ag

poses.name: viseme__viseme_FF
poses.note: Labiodental. Lower lip to the UPPER TEETH -- mouthLowerLipTowardsTeeth* is the literal control and the composed recipe had no access to it, approximating with m

poses.name: viseme__viseme_TH
poses.note: Interdental -- the tongue tip is VISIBLE between the teeth. This is the pose the composed shape could not make: it had jawOpen + tongueOut and no tip control at

poses.name: viseme__viseme_DD
poses.note: Alveolar stop. Tongue TIP to the ridge behind the upper teeth, jaw barely open so the contact is visible. tonguePress is the contact itself. The composed shape

poses.name: viseme__viseme_kk
poses.note: Velar. The constriction is at the BACK -- tongue body humped up and retracted, tip DOWN and out of the way. Almost no lip signature, which is why the composed v

poses.name: viseme__viseme_CH
poses.note: Postalveolar. Lips protruded and rounded, tongue blade raised toward the ridge. Rounding via PURSE per fact 2; a little funnel for the flare, kept low so teeth

poses.name: viseme__viseme_SS
poses.note: Sibilant. Teeth nearly together, lips spread, tongue grooved just behind the ridge. jawOpen stays at fact 3's teeth-reveal threshold on purpose -- /s/ shows a s

poses.name: viseme__viseme_nn
poses.note: Nasal / lateral. Tongue held ON the ridge -- a sustained version of DD's contact with a smaller aperture. tonguePress higher than DD because the contact is held

poses.name: viseme__viseme_RR
poses.note: Rhotic. Slight rounding plus a BUNCHED tongue -- body raised and retracted, tip loose. The bunch is what makes /r/ read as /r/ rather than as a weak /w/.

poses.name: viseme__viseme_aa
poses.note: Open vowel. Jaw is the whole pose. Tongue low and flat so the mouth reads open rather than merely slack. Kept at 0.64 not 1.0 -- jawOpen 1.0 on this rig is 32.7

poses.name: viseme__viseme_E
poses.note: Mid-front vowel. Moderate opening with the corners drawn slightly wide, tongue mid-high and forward.

poses.name: viseme__viseme_I
poses.note: Close-front vowel. Nearly closed and strongly spread -- the widest corners of any pose. Tongue high and narrow.

poses.name: viseme__viseme_O
poses.note: Mid-back rounded. Open AND round, which is the combination the old recipe got wrong by leaning on funnel: funnel opened the aperture instead of rounding it. Pur

poses.name: viseme__viseme_U
poses.note: Close-back rounded -- the tightest rounding in the set. Purse near maximum, corners drawn in hard, funnel deliberately low (fact 2) and jaw nearly shut.
